name: Skip rules
description: Skips songs you never want to hear: by artist, by version (live, remix, sped up), or by length. Add the playing song or artist from the plugin button in the player bar.
author: Resonate

settings.title: Skip these versions
settings.description: Words in brackets or after a dash in a song's title, one per line. For example: live, remix, sped up.

settings.title: Always skip these songs
settings.description: One per line, as title — artists. "Always skip this song" adds to this list.

settings.title: Skip songs shorter than
settings.description: For interludes and skits. 0 keeps songs of any length.
